body:
# AgalarMC Create
![AgalarMC Create modpack title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00e7893e8cecabe8c9f3bc44ac31f47e3266855a.jpeg)

## Content:
- 🏭 A **Create-focused** modpack with many Create addons: Aeronautics, Steam 'n' Rails, Central Kitchen, Enchantment Industry, Bits 'n' Bobs and more.
- ⚡ Performance mods including: Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, and Iris Shaders with Create mod compatibility.
- 🖥️ Better UIs with EMI, Jade, BetterF3, AppleSkin, and various tooltip/inventory mods.
- 🌍 Quality of life and utility additions like Simple Voice Chat, Xaero's World Map, Sophisticated Backpacks, GraveStone, and Farmer's Delight.
- 🔧 A carefully put-together pack with hand-picked mods, solid performance, and good QoL coverage. Still in active development, so more content is on the way. The pack will be in beta stage for a while.

### Also try [AgalarMC Vanilla!](https://modrinth.com/modpack/agalarmc-vanilla)
